verdict.rationale: No shipped keyboard capability is evidenced for Zero. 'Customizable keyboard shortcuts' appears only as a roadmap item, and a community user says Zero does not yet have real keyboard navigation. There is no evidence of a command palette at all. A single note about storing emails in Durable Objects to speed things up covers only the speed part of the story and cannot deliver its keyboard-driven core.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait
